meta.name: agent-memory-systems
meta.description: Memory is the cornerstone of intelligent agents. Without it, every interaction starts from zero. This skill covers the architecture of agent memory: short-term (context window), long-term (vector stores), and the cognitive architectures that organize them.  Key insight: Memory isn't just storage - it's retrieval. A million stored facts mean nothing if you can't find the right one. Chunking, embedding, and retrieval strategies determine whether your agent remembers or forgets.  The field is fragm

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会像一位记忆架构师，主动管理短期（对话窗口）和长期（向量存储）记忆，并优化检索策略，确保在需要时找到正确的信息。
howto.when: 当对话涉及需要记住之前信息或处理大量文档时，Claude 会运用记忆系统来组织、存储和检索相关内容。

say.text: 帮我记住这个项目的关键决策。
say.note: Claude 会将决策存入长期记忆。

say.text: 回顾我们之前讨论过的客户需求。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude acts as a memory architect, actively managing short-term (context window) and long-term (vector stores) memory, and optimizing retrieval strategies to find the right information when needed.
howto.when_en: When the conversation involves remembering previous information or processing large documents, Claude uses the memory system to organize, store, and retrieve relevant content.

say_en.text: Remember the key decisions of this project.
say_en.note: Claude stores the decisions in long-term memory.

say_en.text: Review the customer requirements we discussed earlier.
